# AGA Welding & Fabrication

## Business Information
- **Name**: AGA Welding & Fabrication
- **Type**: Metal Fabrication and Welding Contractor
- **Location**: 8249 Gardner Rd, San Antonio, TX 78263
- **Service Area**: San Antonio and surrounding areas including Boerne, Converse, Helotes, Leon Valley, Live Oak, New Braunfels, Schertz, Seguin, and Universal City
- **Years in Business**: 43 years (Established 1983)
- **Tagline**: Where Precision Meets Steel

## Services Offered

### Fabrication Services
- Steel Fabrication - Comprehensive steel fabrication for commercial and industrial needs
- Structural Steel Fabrication - Engineered structural steel for construction and heavy-duty applications
- Sheet Metal Fabrication - Precision sheet metal cutting, bending, and assembly
- Metal Cutting - Professional metal cutting using modern equipment and techniques
- Metal Bending - Expert metal bending and forming for custom shapes
- Metal Assembly - Professional assembly and component integration
- Custom Metalwork - Artistic and functional custom metalwork

### Welding Services
- MIG Welding - Professional MIG welding for efficient metal joining
- TIG Welding - Precision TIG welding for high-quality joints
- Stick Welding - Reliable stick welding for structural applications
- Flux-Cored Welding - High-speed welding for thick materials
- Pipe Welding - Expert pipe welding for industrial applications
- Structural Welding - Professional structural steel welding for buildings and infrastructure
- Mobile Welding - On-site welding services throughout San Antonio

### Repair Services
- Metal Repair - Comprehensive metal repair for damaged equipment and structures
- Structural Metal Repair - Professional repair of structural components
- Equipment Metal Repair - Expert repair for industrial metal equipment
- General Repairs & Modifications - Versatile repair and modification services

### Specialty Products
- Handrails & Railings - Custom-designed handrails and railings
- Staircases - Custom metal staircase design and fabrication
- Awnings - Custom metal awning fabrication and installation
- Racks & Storage Solutions - Custom metal racks and storage systems

## Service Philosophy
AGA Welding & Fabrication provides expert metal fabrication and welding services with precision craftsmanship for commercial, industrial, and residential clients. Our team works closely with clients to understand unique requirements and deliver tailored solutions that combine technical precision with artistic craftsmanship. We prioritize quality and customer satisfaction on every project.
